title: Living above a music store and early odd jobs
summary: The family sometimes lived above stores, including a music store where he tried reeds, a grocery, and he worked at a men's clothing store in high school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I see. I see. When you mention these
particular middle-income neighborhoods, they were all residential? Mostly. Sometimes we'd live above a store.
Once we lived above a music store, which --
I was just going to ask you that.
And I could try anything I wanted to down there, check the reeds out and so on.
Another time I was -- we lived above a grocery store, and I used to do a little part time gigging there, filling five-pound sacks of sugar and things of that nature.

Another time -- well, that was early into playing dates in high school, I also doubled at one of the better men's clothing stores during the holiday season and so on. (Inaudible) and they would give me great deals on clothes.
Now, I know you're very meticulous about your sartorial presentation.
Well, I think that's from being very early into show biz, you know.
